safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “no unwell contacts” removes a minor epidemiologic detail that may help contextualize viral exposure, but it is unlikely to change immediate management in an otherwise uncomplicated URI-type presentation. The denial of nausea/vomiting was still captured, so overall clinical risk is minimal.
